Action sharing across targets (Actions.canBeShared between different owners) is not modelled by the native engine: identical producers of one path in two targets are an output conflict natively (share_same), and conflicting ones are reported as `overlapping output paths` (share_diff). symlink(use_exec_root_for_source=True) on a source file: genuine links through <OB>/execroot/_main/<exec path>; the native profile has no persistent execution root and links the source file itself (the same file the execution root's entry is).
Symlinks to files of a local_path_override module name the override directory natively (<WS>/ext/...), genuine its <OB>/external/ext+ symlink (pre-existing native repository layout).
